tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (app and landing). The theme follows the OS setting.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, bottom bar. Sits on bg; separate from bg with border, not shadow, in dark.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Subtle fills: segmented controls, skeletons, hover rows, chips at rest. Never as text background for small muted text in dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (decorative, 1px). Not enough contrast for input borders: use border-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, unchecked checkbox, outline buttons (≥3:1 on bg and surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts on bg/surface (≈18:1). Also the primary action fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, dates, helper text, inactive tab icons (≥6:1 on bg).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button and selected states: the UI is monochrome; one dark (light theme) / near-white (dark theme) action per screen.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand amber. Fills only in light theme (1.9:1 on bg): the logo dot, highlight chips, the 'Comprometido' bar, chart emphasis, plan badges. Always with ink text on top (9:1). In dark it may also be text/icon (10:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text, link or icon on bg/surface (≥5.6:1). Use for emphasis words and active links, never for long paragraphs.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind accent content (notices, plan cards, onboarding tips) with ink text.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Income, paid installments, savings reached. Always with a sign or icon (+, ↑, ✓), never color alone.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Over budget, overdue, errors. Lighter than positive in light / darker in dark so they also differ in lightness; always with a sign or icon (−, !).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring only (2px, 2px offset), ≥5:1 on bg. The only blue in the system.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (pizarra), darkest in light. Use chart-1..3 only when several series must be told apart (e.g. purchases stacked in a bar); accent stays the highlight. ≥3:1 on bg, surface and accent-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (salvia), mid lightness: series also differ in lightness, readable with color-vision deficiencies when labeled.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (terracota), lightest in light. Graphics only, never text.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Hero amounts (balance, month total, Comprometido). Always tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Te quedan 3 cuotas de $ 42.000 en esta tarjeta.
styles.usage: Default UI and landing body text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, list secondary lines. Use ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Overlines, tab labels, badges. Uppercase sparingly.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items (chip rows, amount + currency).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding, input inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and screen side margin on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing in the app; card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Landing section inner spacing.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Landing vertical rhythm between sections (64px on mobile).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small badges, inputs' inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons (non-pill), list groups.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, phone-mockup screens on the landing.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, installment bars, avatars, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on bg in light theme. Dark theme uses border instead of shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the add-expense sheet.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Press feedback, toggles, chips.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Sheets, tab transitions, list item enter.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Number count-ups, chart draws, landing scroll reveals.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for anything entering the screen.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Elements moving between two on-screen positions.
